question: Should setup-node v7 be accepted for the Pages workflow without a PR-head Pages run, or should equivalent exact-head workflow validation be required first?
rationale: The code change is mechanically clean, but the affected automation path is not represented in the reported checks and the upstream major includes runtime and dependency changes.

options.title: Validate Pages first
options.body: Run the Pages build and deployment path against this exact head before accepting the action major upgrade.

options.title: Accept the workflow risk
options.body: Merge based on the narrow diff, official signed upstream release, and successful unrelated repository checks.
